in_hebrew.name: רעדן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'רעד' (ra'ad) meaning 'thunder, storm', derived from the root 'רעד' (ra'ad) meaning 'to be loud, thunder'. The name Rayden can be interpreted as 'Thunder Man' in Hebrew.

in_greek.name: Ραιδέν
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'ραιδόω' (raidoō) meaning 'to sail, to go by sea', derived from 'ράιδη' (rāidē) meaning 'seafarer, sailor'. The name Rayden in Greek could be interpreted as 'Seafarer' or 'Sailor'.

in_latin.name: Raedennis
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'ratis' meaning 'counsel, advice', and the suffix '-dennis' meaning 'little den, refuge'. The name Rayden in Latin could be interpreted as 'Little Counselor' or 'Little Advisor'.
